about_the_game:
This is the digital art book for Type-NOISE: Shonen Shojo.
It includes PDF files in four languages: Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.

How to access the art book

  • Right-click Type-NOISE: Shonen Shojo in your Steam Library and select Properties.

  • In the DLC tab of the Properties window, make sure the art book is installed.

  • Right-click the game again in the Steam Library and select Manage > Browse local files.

  • File Explorer will open.

  • Open the DESIGN WORKS folder to find the PDF files and view them.
